Q1 — Easy: Stated Finding

A study of 200 students found that those who regularly slept eight or more hours per night scored an average of 15 points higher on final exams than students who slept seven or fewer hours.

According to the text, what did the study find?

Q2 — Medium: Data Interpretation

Annual bookstore sales (in thousands) were: 2019: 100, 2020: 120, 2021: 140, 2022: 160, 2023: 180.

Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to support the claim that sales grew steadily?

Q3 — Hard: Supporting Evidence

A researcher claims that recent budget cuts harmed rural clinics more severely than urban ones.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support the researcher's claim?
